string-array.name: mock_generic
string-array.item: Unread chats can wait. Finish this one line, then decide whether to step into the noise.
Shorts run like water. Keep scrolling if it feels good. Stopping is a skill too.
A full cart means you are still choosing. Paying or not is a quieter decision.
A dense notes list is tomorrow cut into walkable pieces. One item at a time.
Queue screens grind the most. Wins and losses pass. Keep your hands loose.
Too many tabs scatter the mind. Close the ones you are not using.
The map is calculating a route. So are you, with whatever energy is left today.

string-array.name: mock_shorts
string-array.item: Clip after clip, like a tide that does not sleep. Tides turn. You can step off.
One genuine laugh is enough. Do not arm-wrestle the recommender. It does not know your bedtime.
Your thumb is still moving. If it starts to feel empty, that is the feed, not you.

string-array.name: mock_chat
string-array.item: The pinned chat is blinking. Someone is waiting. Slow and clear beats fast and messy.
A red badge is not an order. Read it, then choose whether to throw yourself in.
The chat is loud. Outside it, you still have a body. Breathe first.

string-array.name: mock_cart
string-array.item: Checkout is where the will goes soft. Buy what you like. Leave the rest.
Filling a coupon is arithmetic. Add objects, not panic.
A full cart does not mean it has to empty tonight.

string-array.name: mock_ranked
string-array.item: The match light keeps flashing. This game will end. Keep your hands from shaking with it.
Rank is a number. Feel is now. Play clean rather than frantic.
Queues invite rumination. Watch the spinner like a small sit.

string-array.name: mock_notes
string-array.item: A messy life, listed. That already helps.
A reminder is not extra weight. Do one thing when it rings, then tick it off.
People who write the list are already ahead of people who only spin it in their head.
